findings: Threshold parameter handling — Verify that custom threshold values are correctly passed through the capture-and-search endpoint to identify_fingerprint().
Base64 decoding resilience — Add validation for malformed base64 responses from Bio Server before attempting cv2.imdecode.
Duplicate scan prevention — Frontend guards exist but backend should also prevent concurrent capture requests.
Error message specificity — Generic "capture failed" messages could be more specific about root causes (no finger, timeout, device issues).
